dump.expr: (()=>{ const parts=[]; const grab=(root)=>{ const w=document.createTreeWalker(root,NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT); let n; while((n=w.nextNode())){ const p=n.parentElement; if(!p||p.closest('script,style,[data-tick]')) continue; const t=n.nodeValue.trim(); if(t) parts.push(t); } root.querySelectorAll('[data-tip]').forEach(e=>parts.push(e.getAttribute('data-tip'))); }; document.querySelectorAll('details').forEach(d=>d.open=true); grab(document.body); const btns=[...document.querySelectorAll('.seg[data-ctl] button')]; btns.forEach(b=>{ b.click(); const sec=b.closest('section'); grab(sec); }); const exB=[...document.querySelectorAll('.seg[data-ctl=ex] button')]; exB.forEach(b=>{ b.click(); [...document.querySelectorAll('#b-steps button')].forEach(sb=>{ sb.click(); grab(document.getElementById('b-ex')); }); }); return parts.join('\n'); })()
